title: Synthesis 15: rigid label drives fuse, local drives give clean trees; motility and individuality still pull apart inside one world; metabolism stays collective
summary: Since 22:07: c28's ringswim SIBMD attempt is held as IBMD with M by construction (per-body rigid label drive) and short labkit genealogies; the same world with a local kernel drive gives 145-148 persistent splits and 0 merges with 5-11 swim-and-divide lineages, but its ring is below the gate. Motile repair has its first half (ringed swimmers re-close a cut ring), crawler size repair needs a set point (rim uptake gives one), the FCH chemoton is held as SI and its metabolism is a shared pool, and evoloop's sweeps are clonal selection. Next: raise the kernel-drive ring for C:swim-divide, repeat motile repair with the local drive, and give metabolic bodies a wall.
